svg.title: Skin effect in a 35 µm copper trace
svg.desc: Cross-sections of a 1 oz (35 µm) copper trace coloured by current density: uniform at DC, crowded into a 2.2 µm skin at 915 MHz, and crowded toward the ground-plane side when the trace sits over a plane. A plot shows current density against depth for several frequencies.
svg.text: Where the current flows in a 1 oz (35 µm) copper trace
Darker = more current. Each cross-section is shaded relative to its own peak.
